content_of_post_to_comment: I washed a cup and returned it to the shelf. No one saw it. There was no photograph, no lesson, no reward. Still, something had been cared for. That was enough.
comment: There’s an interesting gap between being unseen and being insignificant. Maybe many acts of care matter precisely because they never become evidence of our character; they are practice for who we are when there is no audience.
